reviewed_by: Claude review of native provider-chat subagents, waiting-callback resume and webhook fixes, subagent session-delete cascade, and desktop text-size zoom, on top of the prior G9 native hook review
reason: Python tests cover OpenRouter account discovery and exact endpoint-limit discovery, persistence of route metadata after exact-model capability verification, conservative unverified fallback, minimum capacity across active request-compatible automatic routes, typed context-length error classification without misclassifying authorization failures, one bounded metadata-refresh/recompact/retry before response output or tool effects, revision-bound provider/model switch preflight and compaction confirmation, incompatible switch rejection without changing the durable selection, harness-owned unknown context capacity, revisioned unresolved questions retained as authoritative operator context across compaction and explicit resolution, bounded project `.agents/hooks` discovery, digest-frozen hook snapshots, versioned durable hook execution, native provider-turn started/completed/failed/cancelled lifecycle wiring with once-per-event behavior, declared block/continue failure policy, timeout handling and approval isolation, HTTP execution of selected hooks, store-cap paging of turn-scoped summaries, and restart interruption plus explicit no-replay reconciliation for uncertain hook effects. Coverage also includes the revision-safe provider-chat goal lifecycle including active-time, child limits and explicit safe-boundary skill replacement, successful and failed compactor usage charged to the active goal, preflight rejection when the remaining goal budget cannot fund compaction, per-request output allocation constrained by estimated input and remaining goal tokens, durable non-stream goal accounting, routing-budget exhaustion before tool effects, pending-approval rejection before provider spend, project and managed .agents skill catalogs, immutable skill snapshots and progressive digest-checked resource reads, persisted exact-model catalogs, adaptive compaction output, fail-closed restart recovery with explicit unknown-tool reconciliation, atomic single-worker ownership shared by a provider turn and running goal, and provider tool-loop rejection of malformed, denied, or repeated calls without duplicate effects. Frontend tests cover provider hook catalog mapping, per-turn selection, durable outcome display, hook restart reconciliation then Resume, provider/skill catalog wire mapping, runtime-switch preflight and confirmation serialization, verified route-capacity status, durable provider revisions, context-capacity labels, explicit goal block/completion/skill controls without nested forms, unresolved-question creation, model labels, autocomplete behavior, recovery wire mapping and reconciliation serialization, popup lifecycle behavior, and native popup geometry with a post-drag layout notification. Catalogued browser entries cover provider lifecycle-hook discovery, selection, outcomes, harness hiding, and restart reconciliation on desktop and mobile engines, production-bundle paired-LAN real-Core hook use/reload/source-loss/restart reconciliation on desktop and 390px Chromium/WebKit viewports, Assistant settings and provider model-switch confirmation, the inherited native-scope desktop journey, unresolved-question create/reload/remove behavior, and real-Core goal-skill attach, reload, source-loss recovery and provider-use journeys. Subagent coverage: opt-in tool advertisement, parallel child turns with depth 1, wait_subagents pause and Core-owned resume with child reports, late reports posted into an idle parent conversation, parent stop cascading to children, concurrency limit reported to the model, restart interruption without auto-resume, delete cascade and refusal while a subagent runs, and the list/stop HTTP routes scoped to their conversation. Frontend adds pure zoom-step and ⌘/Ctrl shortcut mapping tests. Live-found OpenRouter fixes: tool payloads omit parallel_tool_calls and any optional parameter the exact model does not advertise (require_parameters otherwise matched no endpoint), batched OpenRouter tool calls run one per step, streamed deltas keep their whitespace, and Core shutdown reports subagents as interrupted.
exclusions: No full suites. Catalogued Playwright was not re-run in this live-debug increment. Physical devices remain untested. Live OpenRouter compaction was exercised only until Core reported not_needed under a 4096 configured window; unit tests remain the proof of compact-and-retry. Unrelated providers are excluded. Subagent UI (rail, pane, result card) is not built yet; no Playwright coverage for it. Desktop text-size zoom was not exercised in a real Tauri window. Live OpenRouter (anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5) exercised parallel start/wait/resume, late reports, stop, stop-all and the concurrency limit, graceful and SIGKILL restarts, and delete refusal/cascade on an isolated production-bundle Core; subagents that run commands (and child approvals) were not exercised live because the Kali runtime was not prepared.
